title: Plain-text passwords
symptom: A DB dump shows password column values like 'hunter2'.
fix: Hash on signup (argon2id), store in password_hash; on login use argon2.verify. Migrate existing rows by forcing a reset or hashing at next login.
verify: DB shows $argon2id$… strings; test asserts stored value !== input and login still works.

title: JWTs that never expire
symptom: A token from last month still works.
fix: jwt.sign(payload, SECRET, { expiresIn: '1h', algorithm: 'HS256' }) and verify with algorithms: ['HS256'].
verify: Test mints a 1s token, waits 2s, expects 401.

title: SQL injection in login
symptom: Logging in with email  ' OR 1=1 --  succeeds.
cause: String concatenation puts input into SQL text.
fix: db.query('SELECT * FROM users WHERE lower(email)=lower($1)', [email]) plus Zod email validation.

title: Anyone can cancel any booking
symptom: User A cancels user B's booking via POST /bookings/:id/cancel.
hints: Which check is missing: role or ownership?
fix: Scope the update by owner in the service layer (WHERE id=$1 AND customer_user_id=$2 unless owner role); respond 404/403.
verify: Matrix test: A cancelling B's booking returns 404 and status stays 'booked'.

title: Secret in git history
symptom: gitleaks reports a Google client secret in commit 3 although the file is gone.
cause: Secrets stay in history after deletion.
fix: Rotate the secret in Google Cloud, load from .env, add .env to .gitignore, optionally purge history with git filter-repo, add gitleaks to CI.
verify: Old secret revoked (login with it fails); gitleaks clean in CI.
